title: CouncilLens canonical record
description: The contract every document must match, from any council via any adapter. Strict: unknown fields are rejected so council-specific drift cannot leak downstream.

topic.description: The single topic this record belongs to.

body.description: Council body or committee, e.g. 'Licensing committee'.

stage.description: Where this sits in feedback -> decision -> outcome.

text.description: Extracted plain text; may be empty until the transform stage runs.

saved_to.description: Repo-relative path to the saved raw file.

sha256.description: Content hash, for provenance and change detection.
